test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

The heavy medications and strong drugs at the sanatorium will surely turn a patient __completely lifeless and unresponsive.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "cadaverous".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"lifeless and unresponsive"** can be effectively conveyed with the word **"cadaverous"**, which describes someone who looks pale, thin, and resembling a corpse. (मुर्दा जैसा)

 
 
• **Example: ** After weeks of illness, he had a cadaverous appearance.
 
 
 
• **"Cadaverous"** captures the essence of being lifeless and unresponsive due to the severe effects of medications or illness.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Cadaverous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and why they are less appropriate in this context:

 
• **Tombic** (क़ब्र जैसी स्थिति): Relating to a tomb or reminiscent of a tomb.

 
 
• **Example:** The room had a tombic atmosphere, silent and eerie.
 
 
 
• **Zonic** (क्षेत्रीय): Pertaining to or characteristic of a zone.
 
 
• **Example: **The zonic climate varies significantly across the region.
 
 
 
• **Wasted** (बेकार): Weakened or emaciated; also, used informally as slang for being extremely drunk or high.
 
 
• **Example:** He looked wasted after days without food.
